candidates_not_yet_open.why_not_open_yet: Fill is timing-tested open. Value reads same-row DD (close/unknown) → value-close. O[t] as a number is close-entry. O[t−k], k≥1, is fair at the open.
Representative daily formula is prior-P average (open). The first few rows read same-row G (close). Warmup rows are a leak if mined as open; the rest of the tape is fair.

same_row_open.note: Same-row open is the formula walk, not a teammate label. Do not peek. Unknown → close.

fair_open: Upper rows (lag≥1) of any column are knowable at 9:30. Same-row (lag 0) only if the formula walk is value-open or the fill was timing-tested open. Unknown is not open.
